evidence.finding: The site documents unmodified local coding CLIs, worktrees, diff review, commits, GitHub/GitLab PR and Jira panels, managed browser and dev-server tools, encrypted paired-phone access and free beta access.

evidence.title: Getting started
evidence.finding: Open a local project folder, choose an installed agent, create a worktree for an opening prompt, and run several agent terminals concurrently. The sidebar, menu bar and native notifications show working, finished or attention states.

evidence.title: Configuration
evidence.locator: settings.json; telemetry; worktree_dangerous; activity_log; phone_link; push_url
evidence.finding: The telemetry setting defaults true and sends app-launch, agent-startup and state-transition events. The documented switch is the settings JSON boolean. Worktree permission bypass and phone linking default false. Release builds exclude the complete local development activity log.

evidence.title: From your phone
evidence.locator: Opening sentence; Keeping the Mac awake; From a shell instead
evidence.finding: The opening says agents continue after closing the laptop, but the detailed section says a closed lid sleeps regardless and requires an always-open host. Paired phone access reads terminals, sends replies/photos and wraps up worktrees. rab exposes attention, read, send, attach and doctor.

evidence.title: Updates and channels
evidence.finding: Beta is publicly downloadable; stable is coming soon. The updater checks on launch and from the menu, verifies Apple notarization, replaces the app and relaunches.

evidence.title: Beta.73 release notes
evidence.finding: ⌘⇧T opens a terminal in the home directory.

evidence.title: Beta.72 release notes
evidence.finding: Adds Claude ACP mode and model-switch tracking; wrap-up shows worktree-removal progress.

evidence.title: Beta.71 release notes
evidence.finding: Spaces has merge-to-main and delete-worktree actions; removing a worktree closes every terminal inside it.

evidence.title: Beta.70 release notes
evidence.finding: Session rename, project worktree actions, working-tree diffstat and Changes panel.

evidence.title: Beta.69 release notes
evidence.finding: Chat view reads the agent transcript beside a terminal; live input still uses the terminal.

evidence.title: Beta.64 release notes
evidence.finding: Local project-scoped memory is exposed through MCP; review, approve, reject and archive memory/procedures; unfinished tabs resume exact conversations and Claude transcripts have local search and token/cache metrics.
